primary_question: Predict a particle's remaining transit time through the visible rheological interface in an unseen fluid configuration, using only observations strictly upstream of that interface and declared independent contextual measurements.

primary_target.name: interface_transit_seconds
primary_target.definition: first passage time at source lower visible interface boundary minus first passage time at source upper visible interface boundary in IW1, each obtained by linear interpolation between consecutive measured (z,t) observations that straddle the boundary
primary_target.derived_from: MPs_position/IW1 only; no author velocities or averaged trajectories used as targets
primary_target.observation_cutoff: source upper visible interface boundary z_u; all model inputs from z <= z_u-0.002 m; upstream reference speed determined from crossings of z_u-0.010 m and z_u-0.003 m, both strictly before z_u
primary_target.primary_loss: absolute log ratio abs(log(predicted_transit / measured_transit)); average equally within each configuration×particle class, then within configuration, then equally across six configurations
secondary_metrics: trajectory passage-time error at interface fractions .25,.5,.75,1 for trajectory models

coordinate_schema.x_z_interpretation: metres already present in source CSVs; README pixels label conflicts with observed native numerical scale. Same-scale development companion averaged-position data explicitly labelled metres and source interface coordinates establish this interpretation. Do not multiply these CSV values by 31e-6 again.
coordinate_schema.angle: degrees, major-axis angle to horizontal modulo180; sphere orientation not a shape measure
coordinate_schema.time: seconds, local to interrogation window; no assumed IW1/IW2 global time join
coordinate_schema.unit_uncertainty: Interpretation documented; no independent instrument calibration obtained. Literal pixel interpretation is a falsifying source-consistency alternative, not silently repaired.

eligibility.include: all six particle classes with finite upstream history and observed positive interface first-passage transit
eligibility.exclude: only nonfinite/duplicate nonincreasing time rows for parser safety; no target-based outlier deletion; no velocity-based trimming
eligibility.censoring: no crossing or inadequate upstream coverage recorded as non-evaluable/censored, with all counts and group membership preserved; no claim for noncrossing trajectories

forbidden_predictors: configuration numeric index interpreted as concentration
D_b disputed thickness in main model
normal stress N1 absent from archive
baseline_commitment: training-only pooled multiplicative correction to T0
training-only particle and first-digit family additive log correction
simple flexible ridge model using declared upstream/geometry features with training-only scaling

attempt_policy.one_attempt: new mechanistic hypothesis or substantive falsifiable model revision, trained and evaluated on grouped development folds, logged with equation, predictions, diagnostics and negative evidence
attempt_policy.feedback: send results to root between attempts; revisions can use development evidence only
attempt_policy.continued_work: after at least five attempts continue if either of last two attempts improves best grouped loss by >=2% or an identified feasible hypothesis remains; stop after two consecutive substantive no-gain attempts with no unresolved feasible mechanism

selection: lowest equal-configuration grouped primary loss; prefer simpler model if within 2%; final rule selected before test authorization
uncertainty: report six development-configuration paired effects and 2000 configuration-cluster bootstrap intervals descriptively; bootstrap does not create more independent fluid preparations; no calibrated global novelty p-value
negative_controls: source-buoyancy range versus observed response scale
history/orientation features must be strictly upstream
upstream observation-window sensitivity declared .001/.003 m cutoff alternatives as sensitivity only, primary fixed .002m
configuration holdout versus misleading row split never presented as independent validation
practical_threshold: at least10% lower grouped primary loss than strongest admissible baseline with no catastrophic fold failure is a development criterion, not a final validation claim
literature_access: primary source record, source paper abstract/method snippets, related author2024DataInBrief and established dynamics; logs in PRIOR_ART.md
publication: no publication or general ecological/industrial readiness claim; final validation requires separate root authorization
